newsitem.title: USA: Woman's ashes tossed out by janitors.
newsitem.headline: Woman's ashes tossed out by janitors.

text.p: Janitors readying an apartment for new renters threw away the ashes of a dead Florida woman, the woman's daughter said on Saturday.
"My husband went through four dumpsters but couldn't find the ashes," said Kimberly Main. "Now, I've lost my mother for the second time in a year."
No one knew where the ashes, kept in a small box by her daughter's bed, were and may very well be buried in a municipal trash heap, Main said.

Officials of the Compass Pointe apartment complex in Largo were not available to comment, but Main said the officials had told her the clean-up crew was sent in a week before her family's lease ran out on the assumption the apartment had been vacated.
Clothes, food and household goods were also tossed out, Main said. Some of those items were found.
June Wilhelm, 45, died last year of cancer and other illnesses. Her family had intended to scatter her ashes at Arizona's Grand Canyon, where Wilhelm had always wanted to go, Main said.
